storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Do not approach, do not touch, do not look directly, do not pity; there are beings in this world that are meant to dwell alone in the darkness.

Though it is not her intention, if you gaze affectionately into her eyes because of her frail figure, timid voice, or childlike clothing, you will fall into eternal stillness and silence.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
According to the "Cataclysm Event Record III," the Keeper brought back this piece of Silver Core from the Londinium Orphanage. Accompanying the Silver Core was a tiny, patch-covered teddy bear.

This Silver weighs about 2.1 grams, is slender and smooth, resembling a teardrop. Those who come into direct contact with the Silver will fall into a Stasis State, maintaining the posture of touching the Silver until Awakened by someone else. To prevent accidental contact, Researcher Doll kept this Silver in a closed glass orb and replaced the teddy bear's eyes.

"It looks as if it has been crying every day."

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Jenkin pressed against the crack of the door to the counseling room, straining to listen.

Sylvia's voice was gentle and warm, while Aigis's sounded like a mosquito's whimper, intermittent and hard to decipher.

"Aigis, you need to learn to say no."

"But I... don't want to be a burden... I want to... repay..."

"Aigis hasn't been a burden to anyone. You see, Keeper allows you to move freely in school without any restrictions, isn't that a sign of trust?"

"You promised me not to casually agree to unreasonable requests from others. Especially from Caraboo, helping her with her confinement and cleaning will only cause trouble for our Keeper, okay?"

"Jenkin, how did you get in here?"

"J-Jenkin! I... I agreed to Caraboo myself! C-Calm down!"

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
On a clear morning twelve years ago, in the eastern district of Londinium, a baby girl tightly wrapped in a scarf appeared at the door of the poorhouse. This was not uncommon in the paranoid eastern district, but what angered young Sarah was that, in the harsh winter, the heartless abandoner had also wrapped the baby girl's mouth and nose in the scarf. Moreover, this baby girl neither cried nor made a fuss; if not for those clear and bright eyes blinking a few times under the impact, Sarah would have almost thought she was dead.

Just as Sarah thought she would become another "sister" to a well-behaved child, the then-director sent this child, for the price of one Leo Fang, to the tailor of the eastern district market.

"We can't afford to raise that child. Becoming a tailor's daughter, although she will suffer a bit, at least she can learn a skill."

What can a child not even two months old know about "skills"?

Feeling her empty stomach, Sarah did not refute the director's decision.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Fearful of light, fearful of gaze, fearful of love, fearful of embrace.

Desiring light, desiring gaze, desiring love, desiring embrace.

If only I could avoid harming others, if only I wouldn't trouble others, if only I were as smart as Tiuog, if only I were as brave as Jenkin...

Then I wouldn't be scorched by the blazing sun, nor despised by others, right?

With unfounded worries, the doll cautiously reached out its pale, almost translucent hand from the shadow into the sunlight.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: H-Hello... Nice to meet you. My name is Aigis... P-Please don't mind me! Just pretend I don't exist...

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: T-Thank you... for everything you've done. I will do my absolute best... to not let you down!

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: A treasure that glitters like candy wrappers... I will cherish it dearly.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: I have grown stronger... I'll use these eyes to paralyze the enemy!

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: What can I help you with...?

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: P-please don't look into my eyes... I don't want to hurt you... I'm a monster, after all...

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: I-I feel so uneasy... being looked at like this... Are you not afraid of my curse?

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: I am very anxious... unsure if I can ever meet your expectations...

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Your gaze is burning me... Have I caused you any trouble?

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: I... I understand your intention. Though I'm still clumsy, I will fight for you with all I have!

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Sorry, if I'm causing you any trouble, I'll leave immediately!

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Can I stay here a little longer? I will remain quiet, make no sound, and try my best not to disturb you...

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Thank you for allowing me to stay here. If there's any way I can repay you, please let Aigis know. Would you like some tea?

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: It's so warm that I don't want to leave. When I'm alone, it's truly dark, cold, and frightening...

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Aigis... Can I really return to the crowd? I'm not ready yet, but you've already accepted me... In that case, please continue to look after me... Keeper.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Aigis... Did I do something wrong?

daily.title: Chat: About Friends
daily.content: Jenkin, Diana, Mac, T'yog, Brown... Woahh! Sorry, I was just talking to myself! You ask why I'm reciting these names? Because I don't want to forget them...

daily.title: Chat: About Jenkin
daily.content: Ah, it's Brown! I... I should probably back away a bit... I wanted to be her friend, but instead, I ended up becoming her nightmare... She probably doesn't want to see me anyway...

daily.title: Chat: About Murphy
daily.content: Is... Is it really okay for her to treat others like that? Ms. Sarah said kids shouldn't throw tantrums...

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: If only Aigis could bear this black liquid for everyone... After all, Aigis never existed, which might be a good thing for this world, right?

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: I'm really scared. No, I'm not scared of you, but... I'm worried I might bring fear and sorrow to you again.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Everything. I love everything. Whether it's everyone gathered around the table for a meal and prayer, or the anticipation when the Keeper is out on a mission, waiting for your triumphant return... The air is always filled with happiness... Do I truly deserve such joy?

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: What I... hate? Can I say it? I hate myself for being so useless... But if I say that, Jenkin will get really angry...

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: You are the kind person providing me with a place to stay. I will do as you say. If only I could be a bit more useful...

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Whew... Did I cause you any trouble?

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: It's all my fault... Everything is my fault...
